topic: I costi nascosti che il backtest non ti mostra

through_line.name: la pila di monete viola
through_line.progression: alta e intatta, poi rosicchiata pezzo dopo pezzo dai costi, più bassa a ogni operazione
through_line.resolution: protetta sotto una campana di vetro con le etichette dei costi appuntate accanto: i costi ora sono visti e messi in conto

blocks.vo_line: Duemilaquattrocento dollari di costi in cinque mesi. Il mio backtest non ne mostrava uno, ma il conto della challenge li ha pagati tutti.
blocks.through_line_state: pila alta che perde le prime monete
shots: MEDIUM straight-on: the tall coin stack drops onto the stage with a bounce in front of the big disc, then the halftone trader cutout slides in beside it, staggered
ECU top-down: one coin lifts off the top of the stack and flies out of frame, a marker arrow draws itself pointing at the gap
WIDE low angle: a pinned backtest card with a rising unlabeled line tapes down next to the trader, smooth and perfect
CU lateral: the giant hand enters and plucks two more coins off the stack, the stack visibly shorter
MEDIUM high angle: the trader cutout stares deadpan at the shorter stack as a marker circle stamps around it and settles

blocks.vo_line: Il bot con più operazioni sembrava il migliore, eppure ogni trade pagava spread e commissioni, quindi era proprio il più costoso.
blocks.through_line_state: pila a meta, rosicchiata a ogni operazione
shots: WIDE straight-on: on the grid notebook stage a dot-matrix bar chart grows dot by dot, the tallest bar flips to the accent color
MEDIUM lateral: the trader cutout points at the tallest bar while tiny trade arrow cutouts snap in one after another, staggered
ECU macro: each arrow that lands nibbles one coin off the half-height stack, coins pop away in rhythm
CU low angle: a redaction bar stamps down across the tallest bar of the chart with an impact
MEDIUM high angle: the stack now half height, the trader cutout crosses arms beside it, the frame settles with a slow push-in

blocks.vo_line: Ora testo ogni bot con spread, commissioni e swap reali del mio broker, e quei duemilaquattrocento dollari smettono di essere una sorpresa.
blocks.through_line_state: pila protetta sotto una campana di vetro, costi appuntati sulla bacheca
shots: MEDIUM straight-on: on the dark evidence board three blank cost cards pin down one after another, staggered, connected by marker strokes
CU top-down: the giant hand lowers a glass dome over the remaining coin stack and it snaps shut
ECU lateral: a marker circle draws itself around the protected stack, a check symbol stamps beside it
WIDE low angle: the trader cutout steps in front of the board and nods once, deadpan
MEDIUM high angle: the whole arrangement settles, cards, strings and the domed stack, gentle drift
